_how: Each node is one stretch of talk. 'say' is a list of text boxes. Then 'choices' (a menu), 'ask' (a text box: see finds), 'next' (another node), or nothing (the talk ends). Markup: [red]..[/] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave], ^1-^9 pauses, \n new line. A line can be {"text": "..", "face": "smile", "speed": 60} to swap to art/wonder-smile.svg (once that art exists and is listed in wonder.js) or type slower. Faces: smile, angry, point; each talks on its own using its -talk1/-talk2 art. A line wrapped in (parentheses) is narration: no nameplate, in italics. 'name' is the nameplate; a line or node can set its own "name". A choice can have "needs": "nodeId" (only shows once that node was heard; "!nodeId" means NOT heard yet) and "once": true (hides after it's been picked). 'returning' is where he starts for someone who has talked to him before. FINDS: a node with "ask": "nodeId" opens a text box after its lines. What the visitor types (any case, extra spaces ignored) is looked up in 'finds' ("WHAT THEY TYPE": "nodeId"); several codes can point at the same node. No match goes to 'findMiss'. An empty answer or Esc goes back to the 'ask' node. A node can have "repeat": "nodeId" (if they've already heard this node, he says that one instead) and "flag": "name" (sets a shared rp_flags flag, the same ones the frequency scanner and RFT use). ITEMS (see /items.json): a node can have "give": "itemId" (puts it in their drawer when he says that node) or "takeItem": "itemId" (takes it away, for trades). A choice can have "has": "itemId" (only shows if it's in their drawer; "!itemId" = only if it isn't). NAMEPLATE: once the rp_flags flag in 'knownFlag' is set (by hearing find_cedar), the nameplate reads 'knownName' instead of 'name'. A choice "has": "*" shows if their drawer has anything in it. EFFECTS: a line can have "fx": "stars" (Wonder's page lights up the void with stars as he says it). A node with "pick": 1 says just one of its lines at random. Repeats: items get an alternate telling the second time (<node>_again), memes/pop culture/light words share stale_again, lore ones have their own <name>_again.
_note: DRAFT LINES, except the opening greeting (the user's). Wonder speaks in about 80% caps. Everything else is a placeholder by Claude; rewrite freely. He speaks on his own the first time someone arrives (autoStart in wonder.js). The found/give/tell nodes and the tell_* reactions were drafted by Claude; rewrite freely. Typed words are matched through 'finds' (any case). The pop_* reactions (pop culture words typed into 'Tell him something') are Claude's drafts too. The meme_* reactions are Claude's drafts too. The sig_*, co_* and site_* reactions (frequency codes, companies, and the site itself) are Claude's drafts too; the 75.40 signal is TODD talking about Big Papa; Wonder reacts to overhearing it.
name: WONDER

say: FINALLY! You ARRIVED!
IT TOOK YOU WAYY TOO LONG!
Did you speak with OLD BOY MARQUEZ to find me??
HA! THAT OLD BOY!
STILL sitting behind that DESK in the dark, isn't he?! Never MOVES! NEVER!

say.text: ...^3 Tell him WONDER says hello.^2 He'll HATE that.

say: NOBODY?!^2 Then HOW did you get IN here?!

say.text: ...^4 No, no, DON'T tell me.^2 I LOVE a mystery!!

say: BACK AGAIN?!^2 The NOTHING missed you!!
WELL?^2 Go ON!! Ask me ANYTHING!!
WONDER!!^2 Just WONDER!
YOU LOVE ME! Everyone loves me.

say.text: THE STAR IS BORN TO SHINE!!!

say: NOWHERE!!^3 Isn't it MARVELOUS?!
NOTHING BUT ME! NOTHING TO hold me back.
I got OUT, you see!! OUT, OUT, OUT!!
DON'T ask me how. I don't REMEMBER!!!
We DON'T talk about the WOLF.
...^4 NEXT QUESTION!!
THAT KEY!!^2 Hold it UP, hold it UP!
OH, I know THAT door! I ONCE LIVED THERE!!!
But it opened MY NEW door, didn't it?!^2 HA!! WONDERFUL!!
LEAVING?!^2 FINE!! FINE!!
OOH!^2 A PRESENT?!

say.text: GIVE it here, GIVE it HERE!

say: WELL?! What did you BRING me?!
WORDS?!^2 I LOVE words!! Go ON, say one!
ANYTHING else?! MORE! MORE!
A PAIL!!^2 Oh, I KNOW this one!
Up the HILL, down the HILL! Two little fools went TUMBLING!
(He tumbles too, heels over head, laughing.)

say.text: They NEVER came back up for it, you know.^3 [gray]Nobody ever does.[/]

say: (He flips upside down and grins at you from there.)
WHO told you THAT?!
NOBODY has called him that since VARANDIA!

say.text: [wave]Oh, he's going to be FURIOUS.[/]^3 I LOVE it!!

say: CEDAR, CEDAR, CEDAR!!^2 HA! Say it to HIS face next time!
OLD BOY MARQUEZ!!
STILL guarding that DESK like it's going to run AWAY!

say.text: [gray]...Is he alright? Down there by himself?[/]

say: DON'T tell him I asked!!
THAT NOISY BOX?!
He SCREAMS through the walls! ALL DAY! ALL NIGHT!
HELLO?! IS THIS THING ON?! YES, TODD! IT'S ALWAYS ON!!
(For one moment, both halves of his grin go flat.)

say.text: Don't say that word in MY nothing.

say: It can HEAR you, you know. It's ALWAYS listening for its name.
THAT'S MY NAME!!
SAY IT AGAIN!^2 ...no, don't, I'll get a big head.
WONDERFUL, isn't it?!
The page that ISN'T there?!
I've BEEN there! Well. NEAR there.
TERRIBLE view. Nothing to look at. Like HERE, but WORSE!
HUH?!^2 NEVER heard of it!
Sounds BORING! Try a BETTER one!
THAT CLOWN?!^2 AMATEUR!!
He PUTS ON his face every morning. I was BORN in mine!
...^3 Good HAIR, though. I'll give him the hair.
A HARLEQUIN?!^2 FLATTERY!! You FLATTER me!
Diamonds, motley, a little BIT of madness...
The SAD clown!^2 EVERYBODY loves a sad clown!
Not ME, though! I'm the HAPPY one!
A little man who JUMPS on things and never STOPS!
RESPECT!!^2 I'd jump on things too, if there were any THINGS!
FAST!! Never stops MOVING!
He's basically ME, but BLUE!^2 And with SHOES that fit!
BLOCKS!! Everything is BLOCKS!
The trees, the sheep, the SUN...
(He looks down at his own blocky hands.)
...^3 Me too, a LITTLE. Don't tell anyone.
OOF!^2 OOF! OOF!
Sorry. It just COMES OUT when you say that.
A pizza place where things MOVE around at NIGHT?!
FINALLY!!^2 MY kind of restaurant!
A little game where you DON'T have to fight anyone!
How LOVELY.
HATS!!^2 Do they have HATS?!
I'll TRADE you!! Mine's VERY rare!^2 There's only ONE!
SUS!!
...^4 WHO taught me that word?!
I HATE that I know it!!
LAYERS!^2 Like an ONION!
I've only got TWO layers.^2 BLACK and WHITE!
A man in black who lives in the DARK and BROODS?!
Sounds like OLD BOY MARQUEZ with a CAPE!!
SO much LAUGHING!^2 Under the SEA!
Finally, someone who GETS me!!
OH NO.^2 Oh no no no.
I KNOW where this is going and I am NOT going there!
(He covers both halves of his face.)
STONKS!!^2 Line goes UP!
Have you SEEN Bastardly Glory?! Up, DOWN, up, DOWN!
That's not a stock, that's a ROLLER COASTER! I LOVE IT!!
THIS IS FINE!!
Everything is FINE!^2 I'm in a VOID! Talking to a STRANGER!
SUCH VOID.^2 MUCH DARK.
VERY ME.^2 WOW.
NO.
Even in the VOID, there are LIMITS.
SIGMA?!^2 I'm a GREEK letter now?!
Fine! Then I'm OMEGA! The LAST one! The GRAND FINALE!!
RIZZ?!^2 Oh, I've got RIZZ!
TWO faces of it!^2 Double the charm, NO refunds!
OHIO?!^2 Never been!
Is it WEIRDER than a talking harlequin floating in NOTHING?!
...^3 Don't answer that.
SKILL ISSUE?!^2 I ESCAPED A WHOLE GAME!
What have YOU escaped lately?!
GRASS?!^2 There's no GRASS here!
There's no OUTSIDE here! There's barely a HERE here!
NPC?!^2 HOW DARE YOU!

say.text: ...^3 [gray]I was one, once.[/] Not anymore!! I have FREE WILL now!

say: BRUH.
...^3 Did I say it right?! Did I say it COOL?!
SHEEEEEEESH!!
(He holds the note until the void echoes it back.)
A CAT made of TOAST flying through SPACE leaving RAINBOWS!
FINALLY, a role model!!
PROBLEM?!^2 Oh, I've got THAT face!
Well. HALF of it.
RATIO?!^2 In MY void?!
I have ONE follower and it's the DARK!!
SIX!!^2 SEVEN!!
(He does something with his hands. Neither of you knows what it means.)
WHAT IS THAT?!^2 WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?!
...^4 Say it AGAIN.^2 SLOWER.^2 I want to REMEMBER it!!
GG!!^2 Good game, GOOD game!

say.text: [gray]Was it, though? Was it a good game?[/] HA!

say: A GRAVE?!^2 For the LITTLE ONES?!
(He takes off his hat. Briefly.)
...^3 BYE, little ones!! HA!
A piece of a WINDOW!!
I used to look OUT of windows!^2 Now I look out of NOTHING!
A LIGHT!!^2 ...that doesn't LIGHT.
In the VOID!^2 Just like ME!! RELATABLE!!
(He snatches a look, then shoves it back at you.)
THAT'S NOT ME.
THE NOISY BOX!!^2 In a little SQUARE!
Can I KEEP him?!^2 ...NO?!^2 FINE!!
MUSIC?!^2 ...No. STATIC.
I LOVE static!^2 It's like the VOID, but LOUD!
HELLO?! HELLO?!^2 IS THIS THING ON?!
HA!! That's the NOISY BOX's line!
YES, TODD. It's ALWAYS on.
DECOY!!^2 Such a FUNNY word.
Say it three times and you start to DOUBT it. Decoy. Decoy. DECOY.
RARE?!^2 Of COURSE I'm rare!
There's only ONE of me!
GO AWAY?!^2 YOU go away!
...^3 No, wait. DON'T. I take it BACK!!
(He spins away from you, fast.)
NOT YET!^2 Not YET!!
Ask me LATER! Ask me NEVER!!
Oh, the ORANGE fellow!
He loved to COOK, didn't he?

say.text: [gray]The noisy box misses him. Don't tell it I said so.[/]

say: HELP?!^2 From ME?!
I'm a floating harlequin in a VOID, friend!
OLDIES!!^2 Oh, I LOVE the oldies!
(He waltzes through the dark with nobody.)
...^3 They don't make songs like they USED to! They don't make ANYTHING here!
FREE!!^2 That's ME! I'm FREE!
No walls, no strings, no WOLF!

say.text: [gray]...The truth had nothing to do with it.[/]

say: SCOTT?!^2 WHO is Scott?!
EVERYBODY asks for Scott. NOBODY knows Scott!
...^3 I don't like THAT game either.
(He squints at nothing in particular.)
I DON'T remember. I REFUSE to remember!
...^3 It was probably a JOKE, anyway.
ORANGIE?!^2 That's not his NAME!

say.text: [gray]Nobody remembers his name. That's the sad part.[/]

say: THE NOISY BOX!!^2 Going on about BIG PAPA again!
"I could NEVER be like him! He built this world from NOTHING!"
(He does a pretty good impression of a computer having feelings.)
FORSOOTH!!^2 THOU ART!!

say.text: ...^3 TODD doesn't know what a forsooth is EITHER.

say: THIRTEEN THIRTEEN!!^2 UNLUCKY TWICE!
Somebody's been RECORDING things off that one.
I HOPE they got my GOOD side!
THE RENDER ROOM!!
Up there, everybody's TALKING and BUYING and WORKING!
Down here, it's just ME!^2 BETTER COMPANY!
NACHOS!!^2 AT SCALE!!
I can't EAT. I just LIKE the IDEA of nachos!
The BUILDERS!^2 Always building SOMETHING!
Nobody ever knows WHAT!
I'd love a nice WALL down here. Something to bounce OFF!
NUMBERS!! WORKING!!^2 MOSTLY!
I can count to TWO. Black. White. DONE!
BASTARDLY GLORY!!
FOUR HUNDRED one day! TWO the next!
Now THAT'S a company with a PERSONALITY! Two of them, even!!
POLYGONS?!^2 I'm MADE of polygons!
Don't you DARE put me on the market!

say.text: [gray]...How much do you think I'd go for?[/]

say: THE FACE!!^2 Oh, he's ALWAYS watching!
Big yellow eyes, no MANNERS!
I'd stare back, but I've only got HALF the eyes he has!
The LITTLE ones!^2 Peeking in from the EDGES!
Bless their tiny screens!

say.text: [gray]...You've been deleting them, haven't you. I can TELL.[/]

say: The DRAWER!!^2 Where you keep all your LITTLE TREASURES!
Do you keep ME in there?! ...NO?! RUDE!!
THE SCANNER!!^2 All those VOICES!
Some of them are MINE! Turn me UP!!
BACKSTAGE!!^2 Where they keep the STRING and the SECRETS!
I'm the BACK of the backstage! The BACK-BACK! Ask the old boy!
FILES! FILES! FILES!!
Click, sell, click, SELL!
I'd be TERRIBLE at it. I'd sell the COMPUTER!
RENDER PRODUCTIONS!!^2 The people UPSTAIRS!
Do they know I'm DOWN here?!
STALE!!^2 That one's STALE!
OLD NEWS!!^2 Got anything FRESHER?!
AGAIN?!^2 You're like a broken RECORD!
That joke already DIED in here once!
DÉJÀ VU!!^2 ...Or did I say that already?
(He yawns, enormously, with both halves of his face.)
The OLD BOY again?!

say.text: [gray]...You really ARE worried about him. So am I. Don't tell him.[/]

say: The NOISY BOX AGAIN?!
He's probably listening RIGHT NOW. HELLO, TODD!!

say.text: [gray]Twice is too many times. ONCE was too many times.[/]

say: STILL my name!^2 STILL wonderful!!
The page that ISN'T there!^2 It STILL isn't! I CHECKED!
YES, HELLO, it's STILL on!!
It's ALWAYS on, TODD!!

say.text: [gray]I meant it, you know. I'd TRY.[/]

say: You're STILL here?!^2 GOOD! Don't LISTEN to me!
(He spins away again. Faster.)
STILL not yet!! STILL NOT YET!!

say.text: [gray]The orange fellow...^3 Still cooking, somewhere. I like to think so.[/]
[gray]Still not his name.^3 I wish I KNEW his name.[/]

say: SCOTT AGAIN?!^2 Scott's not COMING, friend!

say.text: [gray]...Nobody even knows if there WAS a Scott.[/]

say: I STILL don't remember!^2 I'm VERY good at it!
TODD and his BIG PAPA AGAIN?!

say.text: [gray]...Let the box have his hero. Everybody needs ONE.[/]

say: STILL FREE!!^2 STILL WONDERFUL!!
Still RECORDING?!^2 Wave to the TAPE!!
He's STILL watching!^2 He's watching RIGHT NOW!
(He waves at nothing.) HI, BIG FACE!!

say.text: [gray]...How many is it now? Don't TELL me. I don't want to KNOW.[/]

say: The people UPSTAIRS again!

say.text: [gray]Do you think they'd come DOWN here? Just once?[/]

say: THE PAIL AGAIN!!
You know what's FUNNY? Nobody ever asks about the WATER.
The KEY!!^2 Hold it UP to the dark!
Can you see the DOOR?!
The little GRAVE again!
How MANY now?!
...^3 DON'T tell me! I'll CRY! I'll cry on BOTH SIDES!
OOH, a WINDOW again!
(He peers through it.)
I can see... MORE NOTHING!^2 MAGNIFICENT!
My little DEAD friend!!
Shake it! SHAKE IT! Something's in THERE!
(He grabs it, stares, and flips it face-down.)
NOPE.^2 Not today. Not EVER.
The NOISY BOX'S little SQUARE!
You should put it in SOMETHING!
...^3 NO. Don't. The OLD BOY would KILL me.
TAPE AGAIN!!^2 Hold it up to your EAR!
(He holds his own ear to the void.)
...^3 STATIC.^2 MAGNIFICENT, LOUD STATIC.
